title: Check every wheel data-files declaration and every retired protocol path
summary: close-the-retired-tool-vocabulary-gate-hole added a shipped-surface scan that only inspected the root pyproject.toml for the literal schemas/protocol, so the identical declaration in packages/assayer-platform/pyproject.toml stayed invisible with every gate green, which is how the residue fixed in remove-the-dangling-platform-wheel-protocol-data-files survived. This change widens that scan to the root pyproject and every packages/*/pyproject.toml and plugins/*/pyproject.toml, reads the tool.setuptools.data-files table, rejects any entry that names the retired protocol directory, and rejects any share/assayer entry whose source path does not exist, so a future deletion cannot leave a declaration behind that setuptools would silently ignore. It also removes the now-dead agent role branch from the boundary reason table, because the assayer-agent distribution is retired and no source root resolves to that role. Tests gain a packages/*/pyproject.toml case for both the missing-source and retired-protocol rejections, and the existing repository assertions keep the retired paths absent. No contract, artifact, or live behaviour changes; the gate only becomes able to see this class of residue.

platform: Platform governance owns the architecture check and the wheel-surface vocabulary scan
agent: No agent change; the removed branch described a retired distribution

forbiddenResponsibilities: The scan must not depend on a runtime import or on the network
The scan must not reject a data-files entry whose directory exists, and must not treat a missing file behind an existing glob directory as a violation
The gate must not ban the frozen v1 decision-state vocabulary
The change must not alter any wheel's declared contents
acceptance: planting the retired protocol data-files declaration in packages/assayer-platform/pyproject.toml makes the architecture check return 1 and name both the retired directory and the disappearing source
a wheel declaring a share/assayer source directory that does not exist is rejected, and is accepted once the directory exists
the repository architecture check returns 0 with the corrected platform pyproject and the eight boundary tests pass
the fast and full profiles, the design confirmation gate, and the document, plugin-source, English text, and resilience gates all stay green

humanApproval.decision: Internal-only governance change carried out under the standing authorization of the refactor mandate in #assayer-group:4c84ee19 and its delegation update, under which the agent and reviewer decide these changes themselves within at most seven workflow rounds. No normative document, artifact, contract, or live behaviour changes: the batch widens an internal gate and removes one unreachable branch.
